(() => {
  const checks = {};
  document.body.innerHTML = '<section id=scope><i id=first></i><b></b></section>';
  const scope = document.getElementById('scope');
  const first = document.getElementById('first');
  const documentTags = document.getElementsByTagName('i');
  const scopedTags = scope.getElementsByTagName('I');
  const all = scope.getElementsByTagName('*');
  checks.initialDocument = documentTags.length === 1 && documentTags[0] === first;
  checks.initialScope = scopedTags.length === 1 && all.length === 2;
  const second = document.createElement('i');
  second.id = 'second';
  scope.appendChild(second);
  checks.append = documentTags.length === 2 && scopedTags[1] === second && all.length === 3;
  scope.insertBefore(second, first);
  checks.reorder = scopedTags[0] === second && documentTags[1] === first;
  first.id = 'renamed';
  checks.namedRename = documentTags.namedItem('first') === null && documentTags.renamed === first;
  first.remove();
  checks.remove = documentTags.length === 1 && scopedTags[0] === second;
  scope.innerHTML = '<i id=third></i>';
  const third = document.getElementById('third');
  checks.replaceContents = scopedTags.length === 1 && scopedTags[0] === third && documentTags[0] === third;
  scope.remove();
  checks.detachedDocument = documentTags.length === 0;
  checks.detachedScope = scopedTags.length === 1 && scopedTags[0] === third;
  const fourth = document.createElement('i');
  scope.appendChild(fourth);
  checks.detachedAppend = scopedTags.length === 2 && documentTags.length === 0;
  document.body.appendChild(scope);
  checks.reattach = documentTags.length === 2 && documentTags[1] === fourth;
  const replacement = document.createElement('section');
  replacement.innerHTML = '<i id=fresh></i>';
  scope.replaceWith(replacement);
  checks.nodeReplacement = documentTags.length === 1 && documentTags[0].id === 'fresh';
  checks.removedOwner = scopedTags.length === 2 && scopedTags[0] === third;
  scope.textContent = 'empty';
  checks.textReplacement = scopedTags.length === 0 && documentTags.length === 1;
  document.head.innerHTML = '';
  const titles = document.getElementsByTagName('title');
  const titleBefore = titles.length;
  document.title = 'Created title';
  checks.titleCreated = titleBefore === 0 && titles.length === 1 && titles[0].textContent === 'Created title';
  const other = document.implementation.createDocument('urn:test', 'root', null);
  const holder = other.createElement('holder');
  const xmlChild = other.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml', 'DIV');
  holder.appendChild(xmlChild);
  const upper = holder.getElementsByTagName('DIV');
  checks.xmlBefore = upper.length === 1 && upper[0] === xmlChild;
  document.body.appendChild(holder);
  checks.xmlAdopted = upper.length === 1 && upper[0] === xmlChild;
  const htmlUpper = holder.getElementsByTagName('DIV');
  checks.htmlModeCreated = htmlUpper.length === 0;
  other.documentElement.appendChild(holder);
  checks.xmlRestored = upper.length === 1 && upper[0] === xmlChild && holder.getElementsByTagName('DIV').length === 1;
  checks.htmlModeRetained = htmlUpper.length === 0;
  const gradients = scope.getElementsByTagName('linearGradient');
  const lower = scope.getElementsByTagName('lineargradient');
  checks.svgBefore = gradients.length === 0 && lower.length === 0;
  const svg = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'linearGradient');
  scope.appendChild(svg);
  checks.svgAppend = gradients.length === 1 && gradients[0] === svg && lower.length === 0;
  svg.remove();
  checks.svgRemove = gradients.length === 0;
  let coercions = 0;
  const qualifiedName = {toString() { coercions++; return 'i'; }};
  const coerced = document.getElementsByTagName(qualifiedName);
  const repeated = document.getElementsByTagName(qualifiedName);
  checks.factoryCoercion = coercions === 2 && coerced.length === repeated.length;
  const appended = document.createElement('i');
  const mutated = document.getElementsByTagName({toString() {
    document.body.appendChild(appended);
    return 'i';
  }});
  checks.coercionMutation = mutated.length === 2 && mutated[1] === appended && coerced.length === 2;
  return checks;
})()
